modelingNotes: Exact26924 is an OF position-signalling auxiliary with one changeover contact, separately installed on a compatibleC60 breaker. Exact ordering column and diagram in April2011 Multi9 catalog printedp.79; also corroborated by 2014 Multi9 System Catalog0860CT0201 pp.42,44.

Terminals11 common,12 breaker-open indication and14 breaker-closed indication. Normal states refer to breaker OFF:11–12 closed,11–14 open. This OF accessory reports position, not SD trip-only alarm. Contact transition timing is not specified or simulated.
Three electrical terminals only; no coil, supply, communications orPE terminals. Mounting and test actuator are mechanical. Breaker power terminals belong to the separate host.
No permanent fixed links. Terminal11 is shared by the two throws; mechanical coupling to the breaker never creates a conductive path to its power poles.

April2011 exact26924 column rates6A at≤240VAC and3A at415VAC. These conditional capabilities stay in notes, without scalarcurrent or assigned nominalvoltage. This bounded evidence does not assert AC-only suitability. ModernMGN-prefixed product pages are not needed as identity evidence and no successor equivalence is asserted.

connectionCoverage.notes: The accessory's full electrical interface is one changeover signalling contact: common 11, NC 12, NO 14, per Multi9 System Catalog Class 0860 p.9 diagram (visually reviewed). Clip-on mounting and front test button are mechanical with no electrical terminals; no PE/bond, shield, supply or communication connection. No conductor is shared with the host circuit-breaker.
